name: @argszero/dsh-late-bound-secret
description: Keeps a declared secret's value out of the durable session log. A message, a command line or a tool argument carries only a reference - {{secret:NAME}} - and this plugin binds the value to that reference at the one moment it is needed (the outbound llm/stream request) while rewriting the value back to the reference on its way into the session log (a shadowed Session.append). Both halves are the same rule from opposite ends, so a value an operator registered as a secret cannot become durable, while the model still receives something it can use. The gap this covers is the case neither of the two existing paths handles: a value that has to appear literally, in a command argument or a header, rather than through an environment variable. Zero runtime dependencies, fail-open, no sandbox changes.
